## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related public issue when one exists.

## Evidence

Name the checks actually run and what they establish. Note any relevant check or hosted observation still pending. For visual changes, describe the affected viewport and interaction or include a reviewed synthetic-data capture.

## Review and recovery

Identify material trade-offs, source/data changes, recovery and the independent review result when available. Preserve upstream notices and contribution credit.
